author: Zlik
body:
IGN: Zlik

Reason Banned: Reduced Knockback

Why I should be unbanned: First of all I believe that his ban was false because, during the scrim where I was supposedly hacking, I did take knockback. The server's messed up kb system lead to several instances where it may have seemed like I was kb reducing to those spectating. However I did take vertical knockback. Again, since the server has a messed up kb system it can make some people appear to take no knockback. I have no history of hacking on this network and I do not plan on doing so. I was not hacking, and the messed up kb system on the server may have caused some confusion.

title: Zlik's appeal.

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
Hello Zlik

Here is the evidence of you using anti knockback: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TZBxYAGsR8s

If this does turn out to be false, which I'm not sure of at the minute myself, I apologise for any inconvenience caused by this ban.

I go through stages where I think you are definitely using KB reducer, and some where I think you are not. However, the main parts I believe that you are modifying your own kb are at: 0:10, 0:20 and 0:26.

Regards

Tazz

replies.author: Zlik
replies.body:
hi,

Sorry for a late response. 
So upon seeing the evidence, I have some points I would like to address because I disagree with this ban. First off, at 0:10 when I slowed it down it appeared that I was taking vertical kb throughout that entire fight. Anti kb prevents no form of vertical kb at all, and I was in fact taking vertical kb. The angle in which it was viewed in made it seem otherwise.

At 0:20 again, same deal. I was taking vertical knockback, another thing overlooked was that I was being hit into a block near the end preventing me from moving backwards, but again I was being hit upwards.

And finally at 0:26, first of all, there was a ladder above my player therefore it prevented me from moving upwards. The first few hits where I was shifting however I did take slight vertical kb but that was due to a ladder above my player. Since there was a fence behind me preventing me from moving back. Also, the hitboxes of the ladders appeared to be messed up in that as well since I appear to be stuck in between 2 ladders at one point during that clip.

Again, I was not hacking, I have never hacked on this network and never plan on doing so. Thanks for reading.
Regards,
Zlik.

replies.body: You were never accused of using AntiKB. You are banned for reduced KB which only reduces horizontal knock back, which is exactly what happens to you.

replies.author: Zlik
replies.body:
Hi,
Sorry for a late response again. Alright so my apologies for getting a confused with reduced kb and anti kb. So at 0:10 in the video, as I slowed it down it appeared I was taking both horizontal and vertical kb. It may appear that I take little kb, however I do. As I have stated before, avicus kb is messed up, notice how both players in the clip take little horizontal kb, however we are both being hit upwards. Avicus kb seems to only affect horizontal kb. Which I am taking in that part.

At 0:20, I noticed that I did not take any horizontal knock back at the first hit, however if I were using a kb reducer, I would stay on the ground and not move whatsoever. Once I slowed it down it appeared that I was taking vertical kb. Avicus' knock back system prevented me from moving back but it caused me to move upwards, something that kb reducers prevent. Again, avicus has messed up horizontal kb, and does not affect vertical. I do take vertical kb in the clips. In the rest of that clip I am taking both horizontal and vertical kb again. The kb in the last few hits seem to be delayed as well.


At 0:26, as I stated in my previous post, there is a ladder above my player's head preventing me from moving upwards, and there was a fence behind my player preventing me from moving backwards therefore I was stuck in between those blocks. I still did appear to take very slight vertical kb despite of this. I was also being hit back into the ladder as well. Adding to this, the ladder hitboxes were messed up in that since I was stuck in between both ladders as well.
Thanks for reading. 
Zlik.
